Name: Leaf Collecting (NitV)
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
Go hunting for leaves in this collection mod for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature in the Valley[/url]! Adds several leaves that you can catch and donate to the Insectarium added by NitV.

This mod was an entry for the October '23 Discord Mod Jam. It originally utilized the Creaturebook framework, but since that hasn't been updated for 1.6 yet I decided to overhaul it for NitV.

Currently adds 61 total leaves:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Maple, Oak, and Mahogany tree leaves (spring, summer, and fall variants)[/*]
[*]Pine tree sprigs (spring/summer, fall, and winter variants)[/*]
[*]Mystic tree leaves[/*]
[*]Lily Pads (spring, summer, and fall variants)[/*]
[*]Apple and Apricot tree leaves (spring/summer and fall variants)[/*]
[*]Cherry, Orange, Peach, and Pomegranate tree leaves (spring, summer, and fall variants)[/*]
[*]Banana and Mango tree leaves[/*]
[*]Desert Palm and Island Palm fronds[/*]
[*]Tumbleweeds[/*]
[*]Salmonberry, Spicebush Berry, Blackberry, and Holly leaves[/*]
[*]Strawberry, Blueberry, and Cranberry leaves[/*]
[*]Cauliflower, Melon, Pumpkin, and Powdermelon leaves[/*]
[*]Starfruit, Sweet Gem Berry, and Stardrop leaves[/*]
[*]Dandelion, Plum, and Crocus leaves[/*]
[*]Tulip, Summer Spangle, Poppy, Sunflower, and Fairy Rose leaves[/*]
[*]Mossy and Burnt leaves[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

Additional crossover content:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37308]Tortilla Trees[/url]﻿ is installed, there is an additional Tortilla Leaf[/*]
[*]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33203]Book Collecting[/url]﻿ is installed, there is an additional book to obtain[/*]
[*]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] is installed, there's an additional 32 leaves you can collect! These leaves are found primarily on maps added by SVE. Leaf list below:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Money and Fir tree leaves (spring, summer, fall, and winter variants)[/*]
[*]Pear, Persimmon, Nectarine, and Birch tree leaves (spring, summer, and fall variants)[/*]
[*]Primrose, Goldenrod, Thistle, and Winter Star Rose leaves[/*]
[*]Bearberry, Salal Berry, Clover, Swamp Flower, and Dewdrop leaves[/*]
[*]Monster Fruit, Slime Berry, and Joja Berry leaves[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

Sankayoudead has created an Item Bags add-on for the leaves added by this mod (as well as other NitV packs)! You can check it out here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33214]Item Bags for Nature in the Valley (and all expansions)[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33214]
[/url][b]Translations
[/b]No AI translations please. This mod is i18n-compatible! Translators, you can either send me a translation file to be included in the main mod files, or maintain your own separate mod translation. If you choose to have your own separate translation mod, please ensure it requires my mod to be downloaded (either as a dependency or as a file replacer), and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[b]Art Replacements
[/b]No AI art please. If you'd like to make and publish your own version of any of the art I created for this mod, feel free! Just set my mod as a dependency and let me know once it's up. Thank you!

[b]Bug Reports
[/b]If you encounter any bugs or issues while playing, please post them in the Bugs tab with a link to your SMAPI log. Include a SMAPI log even if you don't see any errors in the SMAPI window. Instructions for generating a SMAPI log are here: smapi.io/log

[b]Credits[/b]
[list]

[*]Thanks to the SDV Discord modding channel for helping me with debugging, as well as for hosting the mod jam![/*]
[/list]
